summary: Hard cap on cumulative route distance (meters).
range: Non-negative integer meters. Applies to distance_matrix values if provided.
constraints: Non-negative integer meters; route distance <= max_distance.
businessRules: max_distance defines: Specify the total distance, in meters, that the vehicle can travel. This is a constraint on the driving distance of the vehicle. In case distance_matrix is also provided in the input, then this con…
Must stay consistent with: vehicles.max_travel_time. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Values in meters; must be non-negative. Affects routing cost calculations.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Infeasible: max_distance shorter than the leg to the nearest task -> vehicle unused.
Boundary: route distance exactly max_distance accepted.
Interaction: Infeasible: nearest task's leg alone exceeds max_travel_time -> vehicle serves nothing.
Interaction: Interaction: a 40-min wait for a late window pushes route end past the shift -> unassigned.
Interaction: Break duration: vehicle with max_working_time 480 and two 30-min breaks + 8h driving -> working time 480 (hits cap, no room for service).
Interaction: Layover: max_working_time 480, 120-min layover + 360-min driving -> working time exactly 480.
